description:
Most people are attracted to lilacs due to their beautiful flowers and sweet smell, but it is very difficult to capture this scent. Until recently, people haven’t been able to create a true essential oil from this flower that fully encompasses its amazing scent. Medicinal benefits of this plant largely come from the leaves and fruit, there is very few benefit that comes from the flowers. In the past it has been used as an anti-periodic (reduces the reoccurrence of a disease). Some studies show that it helps to bring down fevers. Lilac is also an astringent (tightens, draw, dries tissue) so it is useful topically on skin for cuts, rashes, or other skin ailments. Ingested, lilac helps with gastric problems and aromatically it helps with the increase of blood flow.
